latestVersion.changelog:
Editor Easy — Initial Release

- Launches "Editor Easy," an AI-powered video editor that quickly trims, adds background music, and exports finished videos with natural prompts.
- No software to install; simply upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and specify your desired edits.
- Seamless onboarding: auto-generates authentication and session tokens for API access, with clear user feedback at each step.
- Intuitive command mapping: user prompts like "trim the pauses" or "export 1080p MP4" are automatically matched to the right video actions.
- Handles errors gracefully with clear recovery paths and user-friendly messages for common issues (token expiry, no credits, unsupported files, etc.).
- Designed for beginners and casual creators seeking fast, professional-looking video exports without learning complex tools.
